<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_82mm_mortar_free" text=" -Marks target point, fires mortar after 5 seconds, 1 calibration test shot, then 4 shells per round for 3 rounds -Each 82mm round deals (7.5x6) blast damage at range 7.5"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_82mm_mortar_free_update_alpha" text=" -Marks target point, fires mortar after 5 seconds, 1 calibration test shot, then 4 shells per round for 3 rounds -Each 82mm round deals (7.5x6) blast damage at range 7.5 #####Branch α[Elite Squad]##### (Can relocate fire position faster after attacking, cooldown reduced to 120s)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_82mm_mortar_free_update_beta" text=" -Marks target point, fires mortar after 5 seconds, 1 calibration test shot, then 4 shells per round for 3 rounds -Each 82mm round deals 40 blast damage at range 10 #####Branch β[Enhanced Warhead]##### (Uses more destructive shells, damage increased to 40, range increased to 10)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_82mm_mortar_free_update_gamma" text=" -Marks target point, fires mortar after 5 seconds, 1 calibration test shot, then 8 shells per round for 3 rounds -Each 82mm round deals (7.5x6) blast damage at range 7.5 #####Branch γ[Expanded Squad]##### (Expands the heavy equipment unit, firing 4 extra shells per round)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_82mm_mortar" text=" -Marks target point, fires mortar after 5 seconds, 1 calibration test shot, then 8 shells per round for 3 rounds -Each 82mm round deals (7.5x6) blast damage at range 7.5"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_82mm_mortar_update_alpha" text=" -Marks target point, fires mortar after 5 seconds, 1 calibration test shot, then 8 shells per round for 3 rounds -Each 82mm round deals (7.5x6) blast damage at range 7.5 #####Branch α[Vehicle-Mounted Mortar]##### (Can relocate fire position faster after attacking, tactical point cost reduced to 10, cooldown changed to 3 charges with 45s recharge)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_82mm_mortar_update_beta" text=" -Marks target point, fires mortar after 5 seconds, 1 calibration test shot, then 8 shells per round for 4 rounds -Each 82mm round deals 40 blast damage at range 10 #####Branch β[Superior Firepower]##### (Uses more destructive shells, damage increased to 40, range increased to 10, one extra salvo)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_82mm_mortar_update_gamma" text=" -Marks target point, fires mortar after 5 seconds, 1 calibration test shot, then 16 shells per round for 3 rounds -Each 82mm round deals (7.5x6) blast damage at range 7.5 #####Branch γ[Saturation Strike]##### (Increases artillery unit count, firing 8 extra shells per round with increased coverage)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_105mm_grenade_barrage" text=" -Marks target point, fires cluster howitzer shells after 5 seconds, splitting 8-10 warheads per round for 6 rounds -Each cluster warhead deals 20 blast damage at range 7 -Finally fires 1 round of 105mm high explosive warheads to finish, dealing 40 blast damage at range 9"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_105mm_grenade_barrage_update_alpha" text=" -Marks target point, fires cluster howitzer shells after 5 seconds, splitting 8-10 warheads per round for 6 rounds -Each cluster warhead deals 20 blast damage at range 7 -Finally fires 1 round of 105mm high explosive warheads to finish, dealing 40 blast damage at range 9 #####Branch α[Self-Propelled Artillery]##### (Increased funding, upgraded from towed to self-propelled artillery, can relocate faster after attacking, cooldown reduced to 45s, tactical point cost reduced to 25)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_105mm_grenade_barrage_update_beta" text=" -Marks target point, fires cluster howitzer shells, splitting 8-10 warheads per round for 6 rounds -Each cluster warhead deals 20 blast damage at range 7 -Finally fires 1 round of 105mm high explosive warheads to finish, dealing 40 blast damage at range 9 #####Branch β[Artillery Firing Tables]##### (Pre-observed and charted, artillery can fire immediately, cooldown changed to 3 charges)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_105mm_grenade_barrage_update_gamma" text=" -Marks target point, fires cluster howitzer shells after 5 seconds, splitting 8-10 warheads per round for 6 rounds -Each cluster warhead deals 20 blast damage at range 7 -Finally fires 1 round of 105mm high explosive warheads to finish, dealing (100x2) blast damage at range 12 #####Branch γ[Carnival Finale]##### (Finishes with Sangvis Ferri 105mm high explosive shells, damage increased to (100x2)b, range increased to 12)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_155mm_air_burst" text=" -Marks target point, fires 1 airburst grenade after 7 seconds, exploding in the air at distance 10 from the ground, dealing (20x10) blast damage to range 20"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_155mm_air_burst_update_alpha" text=" -Marks target point, fires 1 airburst grenade after 7 seconds, exploding in the air at distance 10 from the ground, dealing (20x10) blast damage to range 20 #####Branch α[Equipment Upgrade]##### (Optimized efficiency, tactical point cost reduced to 30)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_155mm_air_burst_update_beta" text=" -Marks target point, fires 1 airburst grenade after 1 second, exploding in the air at distance 10 from the ground, dealing (20x10) blast damage to range 20 #####Branch β[Smart Ballistic Rangefinder]##### (Uses the latest chip-equipped rangefinder device, can now fire faster)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_bombardment_fairy_155mm_air_burst_update_gamma" text=" -Marks target point, fires 1 airburst grenade after 7 seconds, exploding in the air at distance 10 from the ground, dealing (20x10) blast damage to range 20 #####Branch γ[Efficient Loading]##### (Gives cake to the loading doll, now operates much faster, cooldown reduced to 45s)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_bombardment_fairy_170mm_cannon" text=" -Marks target point, fires after 5 seconds, cannon rounds deal 120 blast damage at range 15 -Impact point is imprecise with distance 10 deviation"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_bombardment_fairy_170mm_cannon_update_alpha" text=" -Fires immediately after marking, cannon rounds deal 120 blast damage at range 15 -Zero deviation #####Branch α[Veteran Gunner]##### (Fires immediately after marking, deviation reduced to 0)"/>

<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_bombardment_fairy_170mm_cannon_update_gamma" text=" -Marks target point, three cannons fire simultaneously after 5 seconds, each round deals 120 blast damage at range 15 -Impact point is imprecise, three shells each have distance 8 spread on top of the shared distance 12 deviation #####Branch γ[Saturation Fire]##### (Three cannons fire at once now, but the dispersion of the shots has slightly increased)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_airstrike_fairy_bomber" text=" -Marks the target point, then summons a bomber from a path perpendicular to (the line between you and the target point) to drop bombs -Drops a total of 9 aerial bombs, each dealing 75 blast damage to range 10 -(This support is affected by airspace bans)"/>

<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_airstrike_fairy_cas" text=" -Marks the target point, then summons an attack plane from a path perpendicular to (the line connecting you to the target point) for close air support -Each round deals (2x3.1) blast damage at range 4 -0.5 seconds after the end of the sweep, an aerial bomb is dropped on the target location, dealing 50 blast damage at range 7.5 -(This support is affected by airspace bans)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_airstrike_fairy_cas_update_alpha" text=" -Marks the target point, then summons an attack plane from a path perpendicular to (the line connecting you to the target point) for close air support -Each round deals (2x3.1) blast damage at range 4 -0.5 seconds after the end of the sweep, an aerial bomb is dropped on the target location, dealing 50 blast damage at range 7.5 -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch α[Elite Crew]##### (Can enter cruise mode faster after attacking, cooldown reduced to 30s)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_airstrike_fairy_cas_update_beta" text=" -Marks the target point, then summons an attack plane from a path perpendicular to (the line connecting you to the target point) for close air support -Each round deals (2x4.1) blast damage at range 4 -0.5 seconds after the end of the sweep, an aerial bomb is dropped on the target location, dealing 50 blast damage at range 7.5 -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch β[Armed Pod]##### (Fires 2 extra autocannon rounds per shot, damage per round increased to (2x4.1) blast)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_airstrike_fairy_cas_update_gamma" text=" -Marks the target point, then summons an attack plane from a path perpendicular to (the line connecting you to the target point) for close air support -Each round deals (2x3.1) blast damage at range 4 -0.5 seconds after the end of the sweep, an aerial bomb is dropped on the target location, dealing 110 blast damage at range 10 -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch γ[Bomb Upgrade]##### (Uses larger-yield aerial bombs, dealing 110 blast damage at range 10)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_airstrike_fairy_cas_p2p" text=" -Marks the target point, and when it does so again within 5 seconds, summons an attack plane from the direction of the line between the two points for close air support. -Each round deals (2x3.1) blast damage at range 4. -0.5 seconds after strafing ends, an aerial bomb is dropped on the target, dealing 50 blast damage at range 7.5. -(This support is affected by airspace bans)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_airstrike_fairy_cas_p2p_update_alpha" text=" -Marks the target point, and when it does so again within 5 seconds, summons an attack plane from the direction of the line between the two points for close air support. -Each round deals (2x3.1) blast damage at range 4. -0.5 seconds after strafing ends, an aerial bomb is dropped on the target, dealing 50 blast damage at range 7.5. -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch α[Elite Crew]##### (Can enter cruise mode faster after attacking, cooldown reduced to 30s)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_airstrike_fairy_cas_p2p_update_beta" text=" -Marks the target point, and when it does so again within 5 seconds, summons an attack plane from the direction of the line between the two points for close air support. -Each round deals (2x4.1) blast damage at range 4. -0.5 seconds after strafing ends, an aerial bomb is dropped on the target, dealing 50 blast damage at range 7.5. -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch β[Armed Pod]##### (Fires 2 extra autocannon rounds per shot, damage per round increased to (2x4.1) blast)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_airstrike_fairy_cas_p2p_update_gamma" text=" -Marks the target point, and when it does so again within 5 seconds, summons an attack plane from the direction of the line between the two points for close air support. -Each round deals (2x3.1) blast damage at range 4. -0.5 seconds after strafing ends, an aerial bomb is dropped on the target, dealing 110 blast damage at range 10. -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch γ[Bomb Upgrade]##### (Uses larger-yield aerial bombs, dealing 110 blast damage at range 10)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_warrior_fairy_recon_heli" text=" -Marks target point, then calls a recon helicopter from base to cruise the area for 20 seconds -Fires a YAK-B 12.7mm aerial machine gun every 2 seconds at a random target, each round deals 5.1 blast damage at range 3.0 -At 5 seconds scans the area, if enemy vehicles are present, fires 2 x 9M114 Cocoon Anti-tank Missiles dealing 50 blast damage at range 4 -(This support is affected by airspace bans)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_warrior_fairy_recon_heli_update_alpha" text=" -Marks target point, then calls a recon helicopter from base to cruise the area for 40 seconds -Fires a YAK-B 12.7mm aerial machine gun every 2 seconds at a random target, each round deals 5.1 blast damage at range 3.0 -At 5 seconds scans the area, if enemy vehicles are present, fires 2 x 9M114 Cocoon Anti-tank Missiles dealing 50 blast damage at range 4 -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch α[Endurance Upgrade]##### (Patrol duration increased to 40 seconds)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_warrior_fairy_recon_heli_update_beta" text=" -Marks target point, then calls a recon helicopter from base to cruise the area for 20 seconds -Fires a YAK-B 12.7mm aerial machine gun every 2 seconds at a random target, each round deals 5.1 blast damage at range 3.0 -At 5 seconds scans the area, if enemy vehicles are present, fires 2 x 9M114 Cocoon Anti-tank Missiles dealing 50 blast damage at range 4 -At 10 seconds deploys an 8-person squad via fast-rope into the target point -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch β[Fast-Rope Squad]##### (The recon helicopter deploys 8 combat T-Dolls for support, squad composition: 4 MG dolls, 2 shotgun dolls, and 2 assault rifle dolls)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_warrior_fairy_recon_heli_update_gamma" text=" -Marks target point, then calls a recon helicopter from base to cruise the area for 20 seconds -Fires a YAK-B 12.7mm aerial machine gun every 2 seconds at a random target, each round deals 5.1 blast damage at range 4.5, rounds advance in random directions -At 5 seconds scans the area, if enemy vehicles are present, fires 2 x 9M114 Cocoon Anti-tank Missiles dealing 50 blast damage at range 4 -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch γ[Suppressive Fire]##### (Number of rounds tripled, strafing changed to advance in random directions, damage range increased)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_warrior_fairy_vtol_sentry" text=" -Marks the target point, then calls in a vertical takeoff and landing fighter from the base for a single aerial bombardment of the target point. -Drops a total of 2 aerial bombs, each doing 50 blast damage at range 7.5 -Switches to hover mode for the next 30 seconds, sentrying the area around the caller. -Fires the Gsh-30-1 cannon every 2 seconds at enemies within a 55 radius of the character. -Does 5.0 blast damage per round at range 4 -(This support is affected by airspace bans)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_warrior_fairy_vtol_sentry_update_alpha" text=" -Marks the target point, then calls in a vertical takeoff and landing fighter from the base for a single aerial bombardment of the target point. -Drops a total of 2 aerial bombs, each doing 50 blast damage at range 7.5 -Switches to hover mode for the next 30 seconds, sentrying the area around the caller. -Fires the Gsh-30-1 cannon every 2 seconds at 2 enemies within a 55 radius of the character. -Does 6.1 blast damage per round at range 5.0 -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch α[Cannon Iteration]##### (Engages 2 targets per strafe, the number of projectiles increases, and projectile damage increased to 6.1b at range 5.0)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_warrior_fairy_vtol_sentry_update_beta" text=" -Marks the target point, then calls in a vertical takeoff and landing fighter from the base for a single aerial bombardment of the target point. -Drops a total of 2 aerial bombs, each doing 50 blast damage at range 7.5 -Switches to hover mode for the next 30 seconds, sentrying the area around the caller. -Fires the Gsh-30-1 cannon every 2 seconds at enemies within a 55 radius of the character, restoring 2 armor to the guarded character at the same time. -Does 5.0 blast damage per round at range 4 -If the character is downed, forcibly revives them and restores 10 armor, and performs an additional strafe on nearby enemies (limited to 1 rescue) -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch β[Conjugate Guardian]##### (Restores 2 armor per strafe; one-time revive with 10 armor and extra strafe when downed)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_warrior_fairy_vtol_sentry_update_gamma" text=" -Marks the target point, then calls in a vertical takeoff and landing fighter from the base for a single aerial bombardment of the target point. -Drops a total of 2 aerial bombs, each doing 50 blast damage at range 7.5 -Switches to hover mode for the next 60 seconds, sentrying the area around the caller. -Fires the Gsh-30-1 cannon every 2 seconds at enemies within a 55 radius of the character. -Does 5.0 blast damage per round at range 4 -(This support is affected by airspace bans) #####Branch γ[Extended Cruise]##### (VTOL hover sentry duration extended to 60 seconds)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t3_warrior_fairy_armed_heli" text=" -Marks target points and then calls in a helicopter gunship from base to conduct area sweeps for 30 seconds -Fires a 2A42 30mm cannon at a random target every 2 seconds, with each round doing 10 blast damage at range 4.0 -Scan the area every 10 seconds and if there are enemy carriers in the area, fire a 9M127 Vortex Anti-tank Missile, dealing 100 blast damage at range 4.0 -Fires a total of 5 S-13 rockets at random targets every 10 seconds, each rocket dealing 20 blast damage at range 5.0 -(This support is affected by airspace bans)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t3_rampage_fairy_gunship" text=" -Marking of target points, followed by calling in a gunship from the base to sweep the area until fuel or ammunition is depleted. -The gunship has three attack modes -Machine gun fire: Fires 4-8 rounds of 25mm cannon, dealing 6.1 blast damage at a range of 4.0. -Shotgun Cannon: Fires 4 high velocity armor piercing rounds in a single burst, dealing 40 blast damage at a range of 5.0. -Air-to-Surface Missile: fires three 120mm rockets, each dealing 20 blast damage at a range of 10.0. -(This support is affected by airspace bans)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_rocket_fairy_missile" text=" -Refreshes its position every second after use and drops the missile at the mouse pointer after 3 seconds. -Missile deals 120 blast damage at range 7.5"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_rocket_fairy_missile_update_alpha" text=" -Refreshes its position every second after use and drops the missile at the mouse pointer after 3 seconds. -Missile deals 120 blast damage at range 7.5 -The missile splits into 3 sensor-fuzed submunitions, each targeting a random enemy unit dealing 80 blast damage at range 5.0 #####Branch α[Sensor-Fuzed Storm]##### (When determining the final strike position, fires three sensor-fuzed submunitions at three random enemy units nearby, dealing 80b damage at range 5.0)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_rocket_fairy_missile_update_beta" text=" -Refreshes its position every second after use and drops the missile at the mouse pointer after 3 seconds. -Missile deals 200 blast damage at range 7.5 -The missile causes an additional mid-air blast at the target point, dealing 200 damage to all vehicles and structures within range 20 #####Branch β[Bunker Buster]##### (Direct hit damage increased to 200b, and deals 200HP damage to all vehicles within range 20 of the target point)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t1_rocket_fairy_missile_update_gamma" text=" -Refreshes its position every second after use and drops the missile at the mouse pointer after 3 seconds. -The missile deploys 20 high-explosive anti-personnel mines at the designated point -When triggered, mines deal 20x3.1 damage to enemies within range 8 #####Branch γ[Mine-Laying Kit]##### (No longer deals direct damage, instead deploys 20 high-explosive anti-personnel mines at the designated point via cluster dispersal. When triggered, mines deal 20x3.1 damage to enemies within range 8)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_rocket_fairy_bm30" text=" -Marks target point, then fires a total of 10 300mm rockets, 2 rockets every 2 seconds -Rockets land randomly in the area, dealing 30 blast damage at range 8.0"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_rocket_fairy_bm30_update_alpha" text=" -Marks target point, then fires a total of 20 300mm rockets, 2 rockets per second -Rockets land randomly in the area, dealing 30 blast damage at range 8.0 #####Branch α[Rapid Fire Formation]##### (Fire interval halved, total rocket count increased to 20)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_rocket_fairy_bm30_update_beta" text=" -Marks target point, then fires a total of 10 300mm rockets, 2 rockets every 2 seconds -Rockets land randomly in the area, dealing 30 blast damage at range 8.0 #####Branch β[Field Mobility]##### (Changed to 3-point charge system, charge time reduced to 75s, tactical point cost reduced to 30)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_rocket_fairy_bm30_update_gamma" text=" -Marks target point, then fires a total of 10 300mm rockets, 2 rockets every 2 seconds -Rockets prioritize targeting enemies in the area, dealing 30 blast damage at range 8.0 #####Branch γ[Smart Fire Control]##### (Each rocket now prioritizes targeting enemies rather than random impact points)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t3_rocket_fairy_aircraft" text=" -Mark the target point, then call an attack plane from a path perpendicular (to your line with the target point) to fire a straight line of S-8 rockets. -4 rockets per round, 5 rounds total. -Rockets do 15 blast damage at range 6.0. -(This support is affected by airspace bans)"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t3_rocket_fairy_cover" text=" -Marks the target point and starts rocket coverage after 5 seconds, 24 rockets per round, spread range 35 -Continues for 9 rounds, 3 seconds between rounds. -From the second wave onwards, each round will have a 10 radius deviation, allowing for a wider strike area. -Rockets do 15.1 blast damage at range 6.0"/>
<text key="Hint - call - intro - call_ui_t2_kaguya_strike" text=" -Fires orbital laser after 2 seconds, dealing damage to the designated area -Deals 150 blast damage to the direct impact point at range 4 -Deals 10x3 blast damage to the direct impact point at range 8 -Deals 5x6 blast damage to the direct impact point at range 12"/>
